This short document demonstrates the **Quarto Proofread Comments** extension in both HTML and PDF outputs.
Comments use pandoc **bracketed-span** syntax: empty brackets insert a margin note []{.comment by="vg" remark="Inserted comment — empty brackets drop a note in the margin, here placed mid-sentence."}, while wrapping text [marks a span and attaches a note to it]{.comment by="vg" remark="Highlight — the bracketed text is highlighted and this note is attached to it in the margin."}.
Set `enabled: false` in the configuration to strip all annotations for final submission.
